note: Versions through 0.7.1 predate this changelog; their history was not recorded.

added: Invalid saved settings are flagged with a notice instead of silently falling back to the defaults.
changed: Complete rewrite in Svelte (previously React). Every displayed statistic is unchanged.
The sample size in the settings drawer is capped at 1000 (previously unbounded, where a large value could hang the browser).
New visual design, as part of the site-wide redesign.
